description: The International Renewable Energy Agency MSR toolset creates potential solar and onshore-wind supply regions and their cost and performance attributes for energy-planning models. Five sequential Python scripts create regions, generate profiles, combine attributes, screen sites and cluster results. The own README documents Excel control files, a country list and geospatial dependencies, with hourly profile inputs from ERA5. Its demonstrated coverage is 50 African countries, while users can change the region inputs. Source is free on GitHub under MIT. The tool can regenerate or adapt data-africa-model-supply-regions for capacity-expansion models such as model-osemosys. A caveat is that raw inputs are obtained separately, and ERA5 retrieval requires a Copernicus account when the workflow is run. The provider also reports substantial intermediate storage needs, which depend on country size. No account access, input retrieval or code execution was needed for this metadata review.
